messages:
alana_cs: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp — model-mix & rollout impact snapshot. TL;DR: new model adoption jumped, fallback rates crept up, latency ticked, spend rose. Sharing highlights + small logs below.

tom_eng: Got it. Can you post the percent breakdown and which routes saw the fallbacks?

alana_cs: Sure — pasted main numbers: 
```
- rwd-llama-2-70b-q2: 47% of gen requests (was 8% last week)
- rwd-70b-fp16 (fallback): 9.8% of requests when primary failed
- median latency (p50): 380ms (+25% WoW)
- p95 latency: 1.4s (+40% WoW)
- error rate (5xx): 0.7% (spikes during 11:20-11:45 UTC)
- spend: +14% WoW on dedicated pool
```

jeremy_research: The fallback pattern + latency spike matches long-context heavy routes. Likely KV-cache pressure + kernel memory peaks on q2 variant.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout -> rwd-llama-2-70b-q2 at 20% started at 2026-03-16T10:02Z, autoscale policy: conservative.

olivia_account: Customer noticed more truncated responses and one hallucination case. They've flagged it to PMs and asked for an enablement touchpoint. They said: "If fallback >10% next week we'll ask for partial rollback."

alana_cs: Noted. We need to keep fallback under 10% and p95 <1.2s ideally. Action items below.

tom_eng: Action: schedule stress run to reproduce OOMs and long-context load test. Will try two configs: (A) limit `max_tokens` at 1024 + cap batch size 8; (B) enable kv-cache shaving (reduced cache retention). Running Tue 09:00 PT.

jeremy_research: I'll run a quick kernel/memory trace during tom's test and test quantization fallback heuristics. Also propose enabling a temporary soft-fallback policy: if OOM risk detected, route to rwd-70b-fp16 only for requests > 2048 tokens.

sasha_cust: I'll book the customer enablement session for Wed 14:00 PT and include a short demo of prompt-length tuning and cost/latency tradeoffs.

alana_cs: FYI — I'll add a short prompt audit for top 10 heavy users to see if we can pre-truncate or cache prefixes.

tom_eng: If we can keep fallback <10% by Friday, we can keep rollout schedule. If not, prepare rollback to 70b-fp16 canary.

olivia_account: I'll tell the customer that we're on it and share Wed enablement invite. Also capturing their feedback in the account notes.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (11:00-12:00 UTC): primary success rate 88.9%, fallback rate 11.1% (peak), avg tokens per session +18% vs baseline.

alana_cs: Thanks — small follow-ups: 1) tom/jeremy confirm test results in #eng-runtime thread, 2) sasha/olivia confirm customer session invite by EOD today, 3) I'll send a short summary to the CSM ledger with action owners.

tom_eng: Will post results and logs after the Tue run. I'll include the failing request ids and a short reproducer.

jeremy_research: If we see KV hot-shard, we can try shard-aware routing as an experiment next week.

alana_cs: Closing — next check-in Fri AM. :calendar: :chart_with_upwards_trend:
